required_surfaces.purpose: Welcome, approximate age entry, entry calibration
Consent explanation and pseudonymous evidence profile
Daily challenge, rubric result, reflection, next task
Pathway actions, goal revision, plan history
Source provenance, graph status, taxonomy mappings and caveats
Review, correct, clear or delete profile data

primary_transitions.trigger: Continue after reviewing a stateless calibration result; profile creation is a separate explicit consent action
Create a profile with age-appropriate consent confirmation, then continue
Submit or skip baseline prompts; unknown domains stay unknown
Activity submission saves rubric evidence and student reflection; next challenge is recalculated
Review provisional hypotheses and choose a goal or question
Inspect linked source records or knowledge-graph limitations
Use profile review, correction, evidence deletion or profile deletion controls

invariants: No under-18 profile is persisted unless the user confirms appropriate guardian consent was obtained; prototype confirmation is not independently verified.
Calibration is a stateless preview and does not create a profile.
Baseline is explicitly exploratory and not a validated psychometric instrument.
Skipped or absent evidence is unknown, not zero.
No career hypothesis is described as an ability score or success probability.
Source graph unavailability must not fabricate occupational facts or prevent profile and challenge use.
Conflicting evidence is disclosed as mixed/uncertain and can trigger further exploration; the system does not silently resolve disagreement.
Profile correction/deletion controls remain discoverable from the navigation without developer tools.
The daily demo path should require only profile consent, a short baseline if desired, one challenge, reflection, and one next recommendation.
